title: What Is Overfitting? Why Models Fail on New Data
description:
Overfitting is when a model memorizes its training set so closely that it fails on new data, and rising validation loss is the sign to watch.

The dots, curve and loss lines are schematic illustrations; no real model was trained, and a simple line being better is a rule of thumb, not shown for a specific dataset.

No remixed repo; built with HyperFrames (HeyGen) and GSAP.

Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
